properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: X25519 agreement keys are the core of every WalletConnect pairing/session: keypairs are created per pairing through the KMS (CryptoKit Curve25519, persisted in the iOS Keychain), published as did:key, and the agreement is completed at KeyManagementService.swift:173 (sharedSecretFromKeyAgreement) with HKDF-SHA256 (empty salt, 32-byte output, SharedSecret.swift:15) to yield the ChaChaPoly envelope keys. Peer keys are resolved from the external keyserver (keys.walletconnect.com) and web DID documen

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Ed25519 keys are the client identity (did:key clientId) and the signing key for every WalletConnect JWT (relay auth tokens, pairing, session-auth, notify payloads — alg EdDSA). Sign/verify completing operations live at SigningKeyCryptoKit.swift:89 (key.signature) and :45 (isValidSignature), reached from EdDSASigner (JWTSigning.swift:23) and JWTValidator. Quantum-deadline risk: a CRQC can forge the JWTs that authenticate clients and sessions; migration is ML-DSA-65 in a coordinated protocol upgra

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: EdDSA is the single JWT algorithm of the WalletConnect protocol: every auth token sent to the relay (wss:// URL query `auth`) and every pairing/session-auth/notify payload JWT is Ed25519-signed via EdDSASigner → SigningPrivateKey.signature. Changeable only as a coordinated protocol upgrade across SDKs and the relay server; ML-DSA-65 is the migration target once the ecosystem defines a PQ JWT alg.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: keccak256 (Ethereum's pre-standard SHA-3 with the original Keccak padding, not FIPS-202 SHA3-256) is mandated by the Ethereum standards implemented here — EIP-55 checksums, EIP-191/EIP-1271 signature verification, ENS namehash. Not negotiable at the application layer (the chains require it); PQ-safe as a hash. Reached through the CryptoProvider wrapper (crypto.keccak256), default implementation in Example/Shared/DefaultCryptoProvider.swift using SHA3(variant: .keccak256).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: SHA-256 is the SDK's workhorse hash: topic derivation from public keys across Chat/Notify/Sync (Data.sha256() extension, with many further .sha256() call sites in Sources), and the App Attest clientDataHash. PQ-safe; no migration needed.

properties.name: pqs:context

Changeable here by bumping the lockfile.
